info.name: Grafana v8.x - Arbitrary File Read
author: z0ne
dhiyaneshdk
j4vaovo
info.description: Grafana versions 8.0.0-beta1 through 8.3.0 are vulnerable to a local directory traversal, allowing access to local files. The vulnerable URL path is `<grafana_host_url>/public/plugins/NAME/`, where NAME is the plugin ID for any installed plugin.
info.impact: An attacker can read sensitive files on the server, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data leakage, or further exploitation.
